item.title: Babble, 2025-08-25 00:49 – disclaimers and tasks
item.description: Now that I have started developing my files, it is easy to get overwhelmed by the many directions I can go. An idea I’ve just had is that it would be good for me to be able to put a disclaimer before certain types of text, for example making sure that babbles disclose that they’re, well, babble-y, or that any essay that’s more than a couple years old has a good chance of being wrong.
